reason: Review 41 observation O-2 (WEB-13b revision 34, 5 November 2026): eight live WEB-13b unit mutant IDs, which collided with no live accepted ID and so kept their IDs in web13b-id-map-20261105.json, are also IDs of WEB-11a's retired real-engine entries in accepted main's RETIRED list (data-catalogue.mjs). They move, in ascending order, to the next unused IDs after MU-5256, so that every live and retired ID names one mutant. A rename only: patches, files, tests and expected catches are unchanged. MU-2713, WEB-13b's revision-10 mutant retired as equivalent after it ran, was never a catalogue entry (only a comment in catalogue-web13b-r10.mjs) and keeps its historical name; the RETIRED entry MU-2713 is WEB-11a's. Historical reports, evidence and the history comments of expected.mjs retain the IDs they were written with.
